name: keenable-mcp-server
title: Keenable Web Search
summary: Web search and page content fetching for AI agents, with rate-limited access that requires no account or API key.
description: Keenable Web Search gives AI agents search_web_pages for current web results and fetch_page_content for reading specific pages. search_web_pages takes a query with optional site, published_after and published_before (YYYY-MM-DD) and max_results (1-50) filters. fetch_page_content takes a URL and an optional extraction prompt. The hosted server uses Streamable HTTP. Anonymous access requires no Keenable account or API key and is rate limited. An optional X-API-Key header lifts the rate limits, and an optional X-Keenable-Title header identifies the calling app. Tool calls send queries, requested URLs and any supplied extraction prompts to Keenable. See the documentation for optional authentication.

useCases.name: Web research
useCases.description: Search the public web for current pages, optionally filtered by site and publication date, and return titles, URLs and snippets to ground agent responses.

useCases.name: Page reading
useCases.description: Fetch the content of a specific URL, optionally guided by an extraction prompt, for further research and analysis.
